title: Tom Ford
medium: Found Street-Posters from New York City, metallic fabric, sliced and woven; thread, zippers, magnets.

said.q: Galen Gibson-Cornell’s Tom Ford is a bold fusion of luxury and urban decay, crafted from found street posters in New York City. Layered with metallic fabric, thread, zippers, and magnets, the piece embodies a dynamic interplay between high fashion aesthetics and the raw, ephemeral nature of city streets.

events.n: crafted from street posters found in New York City
